# `scene.apply_transform`: Apply transform

Bakes an object's position, rotation and/or scale into its mesh, leaving the world shape unchanged.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(V + H) of the mesh plus O(children)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: ctrl a, freeze transformations, reset xform, bake transform

The chosen parts of the transform are reset to identity and applied to the vertices instead. Children keep their world positions. Mirroring scales flip the faces so normals stay outward. Engines expect identity transforms with scale baked in; export profiles do this automatically.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `boolean` | `true` | Bake the position into the mesh. |
| `rotation` | `boolean` | `true` | Bake the rotation into the mesh. |
| `scale` | `boolean` | `true` | Bake the scale into the mesh. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"position":false,"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `applied rotation and scale to crate (o:1)`
